description: This file is a TypeScript source file for a test loader module in the Playwright project. It manages loading test files, handling dependencies, and error serialization.

classes.name: Suite
classes.description: Represents a test suite, used to organize and run tests.

methods.name: loadTestFile
methods.description: Asynchronously loads a test file, manages dependencies, and returns a Suite object.

methods.name: serializeLoadError
methods.description: Serializes an error encountered during test file loading into a TestError object.
